approved: Family Law Amendment (Review of Government Support for Single Parents) Bill 2018

The speaker argued that the 2012 Gillard government decision to move single parents from parenting payment ($683.50 per fortnight) to Newstart ($537.80 per fortnight) when their youngest child turned eight was a mistake causing widespread hardship, and introduced the Family Law Amendment (Review of Government Support for Single Parents) Bill 2018, which would require the Australian Institute of Family Studies to conduct a six-month review of the cuts' impact, poverty rates among single-parent households, and ways to improve support.
